applies_to.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to Commercial Banks (hereinafter collectively referred to as 'banks' and individually as a 'bank')

answer.action: Implement Expected Credit Loss (ECL) framework for asset classification and provisioning, adopt effective interest rate method, and comply with prudential floors.
answer.action_quote: These Directions, inter alia, provide for: (1) introduction of a staging framework for asset classification under the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) approach, while retaining the extant norms for classification of non-performing assets (NPAs); (2) adoption of a forward- looking provisioning approach under the ECL framework; and (3) adoption of Effective Interest Rate (EIR) method.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force with effect from April 1, 2027.

comply_by.quote: All loans outstanding as on March 31, 2027 shall be brought under the EIR regime no later than March 31, 2030.
comply_by.what: Bring all loans outstanding as on March 31, 2027 under the Effective Interest Rate (EIR) regime.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Directions, 2025
